Interface IOReportSampler

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
@ThreadSafe public interface IOReportSampler extends AutoCloseable
A subscription to the macOS IOReport GPU channels, implemented once per binding.

The two implementations wrap genuinely different native APIs, so only this shape is shared. It exists so MacGpuStats can hold the sampling logic once rather than duplicating it per backend.

IOReport GPU channels exist only on Apple Silicon, so a sampler is created only there; see MacGpuStats(boolean, String, Supplier).
